deltas.description: Current Transformers Qwen3.5 vision forward returns pre-merger last_hidden_state and post-merger pooler_output from the same visual pass; the latter is inserted into the language model. This creates a no-second-encoder MVC feature-tap A/B axis.

Multimodal recovery cannot currently assume llama-server visual slot/KV save support; libmtmd chunk serialization stores metadata only and restored chunks are placeholders. Treat visual runtime cache as ephemeral until exact target-VPS proof.
Separate mtmd cache/media ID from Frank cryptographic visual evidence identity and semantic epoch; FNV-based helper IDs are cache hints, not provenance authority.
Refine temporal perception into two stages: cheap pre-encoder unchanged-frame suppression plus optional post-encoder structured temporal/history pruning for changed frames.
Map q23 results to active Frank-v0.1 work package F-V01-06 and recovery cross-cut F-V01-13; H1/H2/H3 are retained only as historical comparison methods under current program law.
